title: Syncing Libre2 raw data
symptom: xDrip+ with a patched LibreLink app shows Libre2 raw data as small white points on the master device, but these raw data points are not synced to other phones via xDrip sync, nor uploaded to Nightscout.
evidence_quote: I've been unable to sync raw data (the white points) between devices, is it possible? It would be an interesting enhancement if it's not possible right now.
